result:
Round 10 passes all eight acceptance checks (R10-1…R10-8). I found no bugs, and `realVerified=true` because every real local check actually ran. I ran every check myself with my own delay injector, which holds back Electron's `app.whenReady` to simulate a slow cold start. I logged each injected launch, so the delay is confirmed to have applied.

| Check | What I ran | Result |
|---|---|---|
| R10-1 static and ownership | git status, frozen-file diff, greps, `tsc` | Only the 6 owned files changed and `playwright.config.ts` is byte-identical. No `firstWindow` call or comment line is left in the specs. `tsc` reports 0 errors. `check.yml` changes only the job timeout from 30 to 40. |
| R10-2 old code fails | Copy of `499a6f3`, 40 s delay | All 7 tests fail in all 3 spec files with `firstWindow: Timeout 30000ms`, the same failure as C-R9-02. |
| R10-3 new code passes | Repo tree, same 40 s delay, run twice | 7/7 both times, exit code 0, no retries, about 84–85 s each. |
| R10-4a over budget | 75 s delay | Each spec fails in `beforeAll` with `first window did not appear within 60000 ms (elapsed ~60030 ms)` plus the main-process output. The run ends on its own, no Electron processes remain and the temp folders are deleted. |
| R10-4b mutation | Removed `test.setTimeout` from one spec | Caught: "beforeAll hook timeout of 30000ms exceeded". |
| R10-4c mutation | Moved the window wait back into a test body | Caught: "Test timeout of 30000ms exceeded". |
| R10-5 injector variable | Unset, empty, relative, missing, directory, existing file | Unset and empty leave the launch arguments unchanged. Relative, missing and directory paths throw an error that names `TAG_MANAGER_E2E_ELECTRON_REQUIRE`, and no Electron starts. An existing file inserts `-r <file>` before the entry. |
| R10-6 gate and CI replay | Full `verifyCommand` from a clean state; `--retries=0` ×3; `check.yml` replayed step by step | Exit 0. Biome has 0 errors and 9 warnings. Tests: renderer 107/107, main 62/62, E2E 7/7, and 7/7 three times without retries. In the replay every step exits 0 (apt 4.0 s, check 14.3 s, ffprobe 1.1 s before E2E, build+E2E 7.7 s), and `playwright-report/index.html` exists. |
| R10-7 real app | Built app under `xvfb-run`: Open Folder, set Category `DOORWood`, Save, Rescan | "Tags saved", and the row shows Tagged. ffprobe and music-metadata both read `ICAT=DOORWood`. Screenshots saved. |
| R10-8 docs | Read the `docs/ci-cd.md` diff | In Georgian. Timeout 40 with its reason. The stale run-id sentence is gone. The new "E2E launch budget" subsection covers every required point, and its numbers match the code. Release sections are untouched. |

Notes for B (not bugs):
- **Deviation from D-20 to accept:** A added a 15 s limit on `domcontentloaded` and two more error messages. The required timeout message is exact and the worst case (85 s) stays under the 90 s hook. I did not exercise those two extra failure paths or the `SIGKILL` fallback, because the acceptance doesn't cover them.
- **E2E speed:** the normal E2E run is about 0.7 s slower than in round 9 (Playwright 3.2 s vs 2.5 s). I counted that as "about where it was" but didn't find the cause.

Not claimed:
- **Green `Check` run on a cold GitHub runner:** that stays with TM-T0-CI until root links the run.
- **Windows and macOS launch arguments:** checked by reading the code only.

Source was the same at the start and end of my phase.

Files are in /home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/tag-manager-loop:
- c-round-10.md
- c-round-10.json
- c-round-10/ (logs and screenshots)
